summary: FASE A+B+C+D (Emergency SOS, Role Briefing, 3D Digital Twin stress IoT, per-station tasks with schedule) verified end-to-end. Backend: /api/bako/sos POST (no admin) creates events with line inferred via _role_to_line; GET /api/bako/sos (admin) returns events + Italian 'spoken' TTS phrase; ack sets status=resolved and removes from list; /api/bako/telemetry returns per-machine {stress,level,temp_c,load_pct,sos}; /api/bako/briefing/floor?role=&lang= filters by line; POST /api/bako/maintenance-guide (Claude) returns {summary,steps[],safety,spoken}. /api/delegation/tasks?role= correctly filters by line/assignee/steps and includes broadcast tasks. Master UI: after PIN 1985 + admin login, panel-emergency shows emergency-idle; when SOS raised via API, within 6.5s emergency-active with pulsing red glow + sos-event-{id} card + toast 'SOS from the floor!' appear; sos-guide-{id} triggers Claude call and populates sos-guide-content-{id} with summary + numbered steps + safety warning; sos-ack-{id} removes the card. panel-twin expands and renders twin-canvas (WebGL/three.js vanilla boxes rotating) with twin-global-level='Status: calmo'; no runtime ReactCurrentOwner error. Operator floor: Operator toggle -> 'Chi è in laboratorio?' modal -> Mohamed Reza -> floor-unlock-btn -> PinLock keypad 1985 unlocks; mohamed-role-select shows 17 role chips. Selecting role-pasticcere renders mohamed-floor with floor-briefing ('LINE BRIEFING · PASTRY … Torte at 04:00'), team-tasks filtered to pasticceria (Torte @ 04:00, team-task-start-* badge=1), and sos-panel. Hold-to-send on sos-hold-btn (1.5s) triggers bakoApi.sosRaise and shows sos-sent-note. Switching role via mohamed-change-role-2 -> role-impastatore instantly refreshes floor-briefing ('LINE BRIEFING · BREAD, No batches assigned to the Bread line yet') and team-tasks (empty) via mikilab-role-changed event. UI rendered in EN due to headless navigator.language (expected — verified by data-testid, not by string).

minor.issue: New calls with orders_hint like '200 baguette, 100 pane' occasionally return summary='' and batches=[] (LLM produces empty structure). Existing pre-seeded tasks still available so filtering test proceeded. Consider adding a fallback template plan when LLM output is empty.
Returns created:0 silently when no batches present — UI (AutoPlan.jsx) currently swallows this without user feedback; recommend surfacing a toast.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking twin-canvas at geometric center did not always populate twin-selected (raycast needs direct hit on a mesh; center of canvas may fall in empty space between boxes). Not blocking — clicking on a visible box works. Consider enlarging hit targets or adding invisible bounding sphere for easier selection.

action_items: Optional: AutoPlan.jsx should show a toast if dispatch returns created:0 or LLM returns empty batches, so admin knows plan generation failed silently.
Optional: enlarge Digital Twin machine hit targets (invisible sphere per box) to make click-to-inspect more forgiving.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py > 12,800 lines — please modularize (previously flagged in iter197/198 — still growing).

_role_to_line uses substring matching but some Italian role names like 'baguettista' don't contain 'baguette' as substring and fall back to 'pane'. If those roles should map to baguette line, extend the keyword list ('baguettist').
EmergencyCenter genGuide swallows errors with a single toast — good UX, but consider logging the raw error to console for debugging Claude timeouts.

SosButton uses pointer events with force-triggered hold; onPointerLeave cancels progress — desktop testing OK, but users dragging finger slightly on touch could accidentally cancel; consider a small tolerance zone.
seed_data_creation: Ran /api/bako/autoplan + dispatch (created 0 new batches — pre-existing 'Torte' pasticceria task at 04:00 and 'Baguette' baguette task were used for filtering assertions). Two SOS events were raised and ack'd during testing (cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fast path: after gate+login via API, set localStorage 'mikilab_admin_unlocked'=1, 'mikilab_briefing_day' to today, 'mikilab_floor_unlocked'=1 (still needs PinLock UI on first Operator toggle — floor-unlock-btn + numeric buttons 1,9,8,5). To reach mohamed-role-select, click 'Operator' header toggle, then select 'Mohamed Reza' card in 'Chi è in laboratorio?' modal, then floor-unlock-btn + PIN. Role prefixes: role-pasticcere maps to pasticceria line (has pre-seeded 'Torte' task). Emergency Center polls every 5s — wait >=6s after SOS raise. Digital Twin uses vanilla three.js (no @react-three/fiber), no ReactCurrentOwner errors. Claude maintenance-guide takes ~15-30s.
